summary: v2 backend (FastAPI mirror) passes 17/17 pytest tests — new bearer-token auth, protected APIs, sanitized user responses, server-side total recomputation, user CRUD, and orders-filtered-by-user all work. Frontend mostly passes (login flows, products, cart, user management, view orders, bearer auto-injection). One CRITICAL UI bug: after place-order the app redirects to /cart instead of /order-confirmation/:id, so the new order-success-message screen is never shown even though the order is correctly created on the backend.

ui_bugs.issue: After successful POST /api/orders.php, clear() runs BEFORE navigate(). The component's top-of-render guard `if (items.length === 0) return <Navigate to="/cart" replace />;` fires on the re-render triggered by clear(), so the user lands on /cart (empty cart) instead of /order-confirmation/:id. The order IS persisted (verified id=10, total=$39.98 server-side), but the new ✅ success page is never rendered. Fix: call navigate(...) BEFORE clear(), OR remove the empty-items guard, OR pass state and let OrderConfirmation render unconditionally (it already has no items dependency).

Save effect (writes localStorage on every items change) is not guarded by an isLoaded flag. With React.StrictMode in /src/index.js, the double-mount runs the save effect with the initial empty state BEFORE the load effect's setItems has flushed, so cart contents are intermittently wiped on full-page navigation/refresh. SPA Link navigation usually survives, but page.goto/reload often does not. Fix: introduce `const loaded = useRef(false)` and only write to localStorage after the load effect runs.

action_items: Checkout.jsx: swap the order to `navigate(...); clear();` (or drop the empty-cart guard) so users see /order-confirmation/:id and the new order-success-message after placing an order. This is the headline v2 feature and is currently unreachable through the UI.
CartContext.jsx: guard the localStorage save effect with a loaded ref so StrictMode double-mount doesn't wipe persisted cart items on hard reload.
critical_code_review_comments: Checkout onSubmit ordering is the root cause of order-confirmation being unreachable; the FE silently 'works' (POST 201) but the user only sees an empty cart.
CartContext write-on-mount before read-on-mount is a classic StrictMode hazard; should be gated by a hasLoaded ref.

Backend correctly strips password_hash from /api/users.php list and create responses, properly returns 401 (no token / bad token) and 403 (locked user), and recomputes totals server-side ignoring any client-supplied price (verified bogus item price=999999 → final total still $69.97).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend v2 is fully green via /app/backend/tests/test_qa_demo_api.py — run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_qa_demo_api.py -v`. For frontend, after the Checkout.jsx fix, retest: (1) place-order → /order-confirmation/:id, (2) order-success-message contains both ✅ and 'Your order has been placed', (3) order-total equals server-recomputed value. The user-management page, view-orders expand/collapse, create-user form, login/logout flows, and bearer-token auto-injection have all been verified working.
rca of the issue: Checkout.jsx calls `clear()` (which calls setItems([])) before `navigate('/order-confirmation/...')`. clear()'s state update re-renders Checkout with items.length===0, which hits the top-of-component guard `<Navigate to="/cart" replace />` and redirects to /cart. The subsequent navigate() call is overridden by the Navigate component's redirect. Reproduce: login as standard_user, add Backpack + Bike Light, go to /cart, click checkout, fill all 9 fields (incl. card-name/number/exp/cvv), click place-order → URL ends at /cart 'Your cart is empty' instead of /order-confirmation/N, even though GET /api/orders.php?user_id=1 confirms the order was persisted with the correct $39.98 total. Mitigation: reverse the two lines — call navigate(...) first, then clear().
